effects: The signer sends `amount` of the vault collateral (wstETH) to the vault via safeTransferFrom. This spends the signer's wstETH allowance to the vault.
Active vault shares worth the deposited amount are credited to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily to the signer.
The call reverts if a deposit whitelist excludes the signer or the deposit limit would be exceeded. It moves nothing else.
formats.shown: Deposit {amount} wstETH for {onBehalfOf} into the named vault, with the vault, the amount and the beneficiary as fields.

findings.title: deposit: the wstETH token is hardcoded for 50 vaults, but collateral is a per-vault storage value
findings.evidence: descriptor.json metadata.constants.underlyingToken = 0x7f39C5…2Ca0 (wstETH). Vault.sol _initialize: `collateral = params.collateral;`. Only 0x08144d…'s constructor data confirms collateral 0x7f39c5…; the other 49 vaults' collateral is taken from the case descriptions ("Deposit wstETH into …").
findings.fix: Confirm that every listed deployment has collateral() == wstETH. Move any vault with different collateral to its own descriptor.

effects: Burns the signer's active shares worth `amount` wstETH, rounded up (previewWithdraw, Ceil).
Mints withdrawal shares for `amount` wstETH in epoch currentEpoch()+1 to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can later claim the wstETH.
No tokens move now. The queued amount stays slashable until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Request {amount} wstETH withdrawal for {claimer}, with the vault, the requested assets and the claim owner as fields.

findings.title: withdraw: the epoch delay and the slashing exposure of the queued amount are not shown
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; withdrawalSharesOf[epoch][claimer] += mintedShares;`. onSlash reduces withdrawals[currentEpoch_+1]. The unlock epoch is derived from storage.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Mints withdrawal shares to `claimer` in epoch currentEpoch()+1. Their value is previewRedeem(shares) wstETH, and only `claimer` can claim it later.
No tokens move now. The wstETH amount is derived from the vault's current ratio.
formats.shown: Queue {shares} raw shares for {claimer}: the share count is a raw 18-decimal integer, and the claim owner and vault are shown.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw 18-decimal integer and is hard to read
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem `#.shares` format "raw". Case 54 screen: "Queue 2250000000000000000 raw shares". ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares share wstETH's 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use format "unit" with params {"decimals":18,"base":"shares"} so the screen shows "2.25 shares".

findings.title: redeem: the wstETH value of the redeemed shares is computed on-chain and cannot be shown

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Transfers withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) wstETH from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}, with the vault, the epoch and the recipient as fields. The token and amount are not named.

findings.title: claim: the intent never says wstETH is paid out, so the signer can't tell what asset the recipient gets
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. descriptor intent "Claim withdrawal" and interpolatedIntent "Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}".
findings.fix: Use intent "Claim wstETH withdrawal" and interpolatedIntent "Claim wstETH from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claim: the amount paid out comes from storage and cannot be shown

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Transfers the sum of withdrawalsOf(epoch, signer) over all listed epochs, in wstETH, from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim epochs {list} to {recipient}, with the vault, each epoch and the recipient as fields. The token and amount are not named.

findings.title: claimBatch: the intent never says wstETH is paid out to the recipient
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. descriptor intent "Claim withdrawals" and interpolatedIntent "Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".
findings.fix: Use intent "Claim wstETH withdrawals" and interpolatedIntent "Claim wstETH from epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}".

findings.title: claimBatch: the total amount paid out comes from storage and cannot be shown
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i]);` where _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender).
